name: Cover figure
sizes_dp_sp: 168 sp, line 1, tracking -6; coverFigure.marginLeft 0; no font scaling
states: in10 (5-9); Toss-up / Juego parejo if pFav < 0.55 (digit not shown); More than 9 in 10 if pFav >= 0.95, n stays 9. Never 10.
fontScale: maxFontSizeMultiplier 1.0 (does not grow). At 1.3 the block stacks (coverFigure.stackFromFontScale). At 100% the 168 figure needs scroll to reach the footer.
a11y: contentDescription from tb.cover. Cream on bg 14.32:1. The figure is calculated: pFav = max(p, 1-p), n = clamp(round_half_up(pFav*10), 5, 9).

name: Mini field (row / strip)
tokens: field.rowHeight; field.modelRing; field.modelStroke; field.x; field.clampX; field.marketCross (not painted here)
sizes_dp_sp: Week: 328 x 24 dp. Widget 4x2: widget.miniField 152 x 48 dp. Ring 16 dp, stroke 3. Caps 2 dp in #30363C, no filled end zones.
states: Only the model O. Label is the named favorite probability. Position still uses home p (x = 30 + 3p). No market X, no yard numbers.
fontScale: Field labels type.fieldLabel 14/16, max 1.3. Geometry does not scale with font.
strings_keys: tb.field (model-only). Percents stay "72%" in both locales.
a11y: tb.field describes the favorite percent and the ring. Ring contrast modelOnPlayField 4.94:1. Ticks are texture only (1.72:1). 50% line cream 60% composites to 6.18:1. field.labelSeparateUnder is unused on primary fields after H2 (only one label).

name: Detail field
tokens: field.width 360; field.endZone 30; field.play 300; field.detailHeight 112; field.markerClamp [38, 322]; darkPalette.crimsonHero
sizes_dp_sp: 360 x 112 dp. Both end zones #9A3350. Marker centers clamped to [38, 322].
states: Same as mini field: O only, favorite-percent label, home p for x. Live and pre-kickoff share the field. Finals hide the cover and keep the field if useful; typographic score is the hero.
fontScale: Labels type.fieldLabel max 1.3. The 168 cover does not scale.
a11y: Named favorite values, e.g. "Hawks 70% model". Cream on crimsonHero 6.12:1 in the end zones. Do not use blueHero in this UI.

name: Week row
tokens: type.teams; type.rowFigure; type.kicker; type.scoreRow; type.scoreName; radius.none; teamLogos.sizeRow; nav.listPaddingBottom
sizes_dp_sp: Min height about 132 dp with 24 dp field. Logo column 24 dp. Row figure 48 sp. Compact final scores type.scoreRow 22 sp mono, names type.scoreName 18. Logo slot 24 dp, no color plate.
states: Upcoming, live, FINAL, tie. No Disagree chip, no market chip. 14-16 games, none featured. Typographic finals (winner 700, loser muted).
fontScale: type.teams max 1.5; type.rowFigure max 1.15; type.scoreRow max 1.3. Times and names nowrap; short name before ellipsis. Validate at 100, 135, 200%.
strings_keys: chip.final; chip.live; chip.tie; chip.tossup; cover.in10.short; when.*; tb.row
a11y: Row is one accessibility focus where possible. Logos: see Logo slot. Cream / muted on surface meet AA (12.34 / 5.69). type.rowFigureFinal (40 sans) is unused; compact finals use scoreRow.

name: Masthead
sizes_dp_sp: Title 24/30 sp. Kicker 12/16 mono, tracking 1.2, uppercase. Collapses on scroll; do not split the wordmark if it appears. Expanded week title plus "Week of {date}".
states: Expanded and collapsed. Collapsed keeps the week stamp visible.
a11y: English default. Stamp uses locale format. Contrast cream on bg 14.32:1.

name: FINAL kicker
surface: Week row; Detail hero; widget (if the next game is final, not the default next-kickoff state)
sizes_dp_sp: 12/16 sp, IBM Plex Mono 500, letter-spacing 1.2, uppercase.
states: FINAL / FINAL (same in ES). Also LIVE / EN JUEGO and TIE / EMPATE use the same kicker token. No cream 24 dp circle, no check stamp.
a11y: contentDescription is the visible word. Pair with typographic scores, not with a mark.

name: Footer with link
states: Always the experiment line plus a link to How it is calculated. No market mention.
fontScale: max 1.5. Spanish is longer; wrap, do not truncate.
a11y: Link has an explicit role and name ("How it is calculated" / "Cómo se calcula"). Muted on bg 6.6:1, cream link 14.32:1.

name: 10-of-10 dots
sizes_dp_sp: 16 dp dots, 8 dp gap, 10 dots. n of them on (5-9). Toss-up uses 5 on, but the digit is not shown. More than 9 still lights 9.
states: Filled cream for n, empty #30363C for the rest. Never 10 of 10.
fontScale: Geometry does not scale. The cover phrase around it follows type.subtitle / body at max 1.5, except the 168 figure.
a11y: Decorative relative to tb.cover; hide from a11y tree or mark as hidden so the phrase is not read twice.

name: History dumbbell
surface: History only (and explained in How it is calculated)
sizes_dp_sp: Model O 16 dp / stroke 3. Market X 12 dp / stroke 2 (field.marketCross). Axis is log loss by week, no winner color.
states: Reference only. Honest line on the cream tile. Correct calls is model vs outcome, not a row stamp.
fontScale: Labels max 1.5. Log loss uses a period in EN (0.559) and a comma in ES (0,559).
strings_keys: hist.title; hist.sub; hist.honest; how.honest; hist.calls; hist.calls.note; tb.dumbbell
a11y: tb.dumbbell describes both marks as reference, not as a pick. O contrast 4.94, X 7.11 on the play field. No logos on week-level dumbbells.

name: Bottom nav
tokens: nav.height; nav.item; nav.icon; nav.indicator; nav.sideMargin; nav.bottomGap; nav.listPaddingBottom; type.navLabel
sizes_dp_sp: Bar 64 dp. Item 109 x 64. Icon 24. Cream indicator 56 x 32 behind the icon only. Label 12/16. paddingBottom = 64 + 12 + inset + 16.
states: Week / History / Settings. Active: cream icon and label. Inactive: muted. Detail uses a 64 dp back bar instead.
fontScale: type.navLabel max 1.3. Labels "Week" / "Semana", "History" / "Historial", "Settings" / "Ajustes" must not truncate.
a11y: contentDescription equals the label. Hit target 64 dp tall. Indicator is decorative.

name: Language selector
sizes_dp_sp: Each option minHeight 48 dp, radio 20 dp. Three options in a column.
states: System default / Predeterminado del sistema; English / English; Español / Español. Selected radio is cream. English is the default. Spanish if the phone is in Spanish, or if chosen here.
fontScale: type.body max 1.5. "Predeterminado del sistema" must wrap inside the row, not clip.
a11y: Radio group. contentDescription is the option label plus selected state. Cream on surface 12.34:1.

name: Widget 2x2
tokens: widget.size2x2; widget.padX; widget.padY; type.widgetFigure; type.widgetPhrase; type.kicker; type.teams; radius (system_app_widget_background_radius)
sizes_dp_sp: 156 x 156 dp. Padding 12 x 10. Figure 28 sp, phrase 13 sp. Short name 16/20 700. No logo slot.
states: Published, empty (brand + one line), offline with cache (published content + one-line kicker), offline no cache, monochrome Android 12+ (onSurface, no yellow, no blue, no crimson band). Default published: kicker, short name, "7 in 10" (name is already the title), updated.
fontScale: widgetFigure max 1.15. Name and kicker follow type.teams / kicker caps. Measure the longest short name on device; ellipsis is last resort.
strings_keys: wid.next; wid.updated.short; wid.offline.short; wid.empty; wid.offline.empty; cover.in10.short; chip.tossup
a11y: Tap: endzone://game/{id}. Refresh at most every 60 min. contentDescription names the favorite and the figure. No logo: a 24 dp slot would crowd the short name and the figure in 156 dp.

name: Widget 4x2
tokens: widget.size4x2; widget.miniField; type.widgetFigure; type.widgetPhrase; type.widgetMatch; type.kicker; teamLogos.sizeRow
sizes_dp_sp: 328 x 156 dp. Mini field 152 x 48. Figure 28 sp plus 13 sp "in 10 {team}". Match line 14/18 Jost 400. Logo pair 24 dp above the mini field (not beside the match line, which would truncate Halcones en Estrellas")
fontScale: Same five states as 2x2. Published: kicker, logos + "Hawks at Stars" at weight 400, "7 in 10 Hawks" / "7 de 10 Halcones", mini field with only the model O, updated. Toss-up: phrase only, no name. More than 9 uses wid.cover.more9 so it fits the left column.
strings_keys: widgetFigure max 1.15; widgetMatch max 1.3. Match stays one line (nowrap). Spanish 20-30% longer, validate at 1.3.
a11y: wid.cover; wid.cover.more9; detail.compact; wid.updated; wid.offline.line; wid.empty; logo.cd
column9: Tap endzone://game/{id}. Match line is weight 400, not 500 (type.widgetMatch). Logos use the Logo slot rules. contentDescription includes the named figure and the match.

name: Widget 4x1
sizes_dp_sp: 328 x 72 dp, inner width 304 dp after padX 12. Figure 24 sp plus 13 sp phrase. No match line. No logo slot.
states: Kicker + "7 in 10 Hawks" / "7 de 10 Halcones". Toss-up: phrase only. More than 9: wid.cover.more9 ("More than 9 {team}" / "Más de 9 {team}"). Same empty / offline / mono states, compressed to one row.
fontScale: At 1.3, the longest short names were measured: ES Estrellas (9), EN Atlantic / Northern (8). Match line plus "7 de 10 Estrellas" overflowed 304 dp, so 4x1 drops the match line. A 24 dp logo would break the named figure, so 4x1 has no logo.
a11y: Tap endzone://game/{id}. contentDescription is the kicker plus the named figure. Must not truncate at 100% or 135% with Estrellas / Atlantic.

name: Logo slot
surface: Week rows, Detail header (and compact bar), widget 4x2. Not 2x2, not 4x1. Not on History week-level dumbbells.
tokens: teamLogos.flag; teamLogos.sizeRow; teamLogos.sizeHeader; teamLogos.sizeBar; teamLogos.cacheTtlDays; darkPalette.surfaceRaised; darkPalette.border
sizes_dp_sp: 24 dp on Week rows, widget 4x2, and the compact Detail bar. 32 dp on the Detail heading. No color plate behind the logo, no color border. The logo is never an accent.
states: Flag teamLogos.enabled. If off: skip to monogram. If on: disk cache keyed by team id (TTL 7 days), then network (public nflverse URLs at runtime), then monogram. On the boards the loaded state is a generic #30363C circle or shield labeled "team logo (runtime)". Logos are not stored in the repo or the APK. Kit and site do not change.
fontScale: Slot size is fixed in dp and does not scale with font.
strings_keys: logo.cd; logo.cd.loading; logo.caption (annotation only, never inside the 24-32 dp slot)
a11y: contentDescription "{team} logo" / "Logo de {team}" when a logo is showing or loading (logo.cd / logo.cd.loading). Do not download or imitate real marks in mocks or in the APK.

name: Monogram
surface: Fallback for the logo slot (flag off, cache miss plus network failure, or load error)
sizes_dp_sp: Same 24 or 32 dp slot. 2 or 3 letter fictional abbreviation, Jost 700. Team color is a 1.5 dp ring or a 5 dp dot, never a solid fill. Text cream on #262B30.
states: Default variant: ring. Dot is an allowed alternative, shown on H2_logos.png. Abbreviations and ring colors are fictional (not NFL codes or palettes).
fontScale: Type size inside the slot is fixed (about 8 sp at 24 dp, 10 sp at 32 dp) and does not follow the cover figure.
a11y: contentDescription "{team}" / "{team}" (logo.cd.mono), not "{team} logo". Cream on surface 12.34:1 (AA). The ring is a 1.5 dp graphic; use fictional muted colors, not real NFL colors.
